e: In the beginning Elohim created
the heavens and the earth.

t: וְרוּחָא מִן קֳדָם יְיָ מְנַשְּׁבָא עַל אַפֵּי מַיָּא:
e: The earth was unformed and desolate,
and (there was) darkness [was spread] over the surface of the abyss.
The breath of [from before] Elohim hovered [blew] above the surface of the water.
Elohim said, Let there be light.
and there was light.

h: וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
t: וַחֲזָא יְיָ יָת נְהוֹרָא אֲרֵי טָב
וְאַפְרֵשׁ יְיָ בֵּין נְהוֹרָא וּבֵין חֲשׁוֹכָא:
e: Elohim saw that the light was good,
and Elohim divided the light from the darkness.

t: וַהֲוָה רְמַשׁ וַהֲוָה צְפַר יוֹמָא חָד:
e: Elohim called the light day,
and the darkness He called night.
It became evening and it became morning, one day.
Elohim said,
Let there be a canopy in the midst [middle] of the waters,
and let it divide between waters and waters.

h: וַיַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ
t: וְאַפְרֵישׁ בֵּין מַיָּא דִּי מִלְרַע לִרְקִיעָא
e: Elohim made the canopy,
and divided the waters which were beneath the canopy,
from the waters which were above the canopy,
and it was so.

t: וַהֲוָה רְמַשׁ וַהֲוָה צְפַר יוֹם תִּנְיָן:
e: Elohim called the canopy heaven.
It became evening and it became morning the second day.

h: יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד
t: יִתְכַּנְשׁוּן מַיָּא מִתְּחוֹת שְׁמַיָּא לַאֲתַר חָד
e: Elohim said,
Let the waters beneath the heavens be gathered into one place,
and let the dryness be seen.
It was so.
Elohim called the dryness, earth,
and the gathering of the waters, He called seas,
and Elohim saw that it was good.
